mapper.insert: INSERT INTO conversation_contexts (user_id, summary, summarized_through_message_id, last_intent, last_confidence, last_resolved_message_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{summary}, #{summarizedThroughMessageId}, #{lastIntent}, #{lastConfidence}, #{lastResolvedMessageId}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}) ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO NOTHING
